name: Shield KYA
description: Installs Shield KYA (@shield-agent/kya), the Know Your Agent CLI, globally with npm. Optionally wires its Claude Code hook.

version.description: Version of @shield-agent/kya to install from npm, for example 0.32.7, or latest.

installHook.description: Also run 'kya connect claude --hooks' for the remote user. Wires the Claude Code PreToolUse hook and the MCP entry in the user's home.
